description: Per-position conservation across the TAX-2 CNBD, pocket positions highlighted
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
cp=pd.read_csv("out/conservation_per_position.csv")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6),sharex=True,gridspec_kw={"hspace":0.18})
for ax,col,ttl,c in [(axes[0],"id_nematode_orthologs","Identity across 5 nematode TAX-2 orthologs","#2d6a4f"),
                     (axes[1],"id_cnbd_panel","Identity across the 8-protein CNBD panel (TAX-4, CNGA1/2/3, CNGB1/3, HCN2, PKA RIalpha)","#1d3f6e")]:
    ax.bar(cp["pos"],cp[col],color=np.where(cp["pocket"],"#d1495b",c),width=0.85)
    ax.set_ylabel("fraction identical"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05)
    ax.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10,loc="left")
    for p in cp.loc[cp["pocket"],"pos"]:
        ax.text(p,1.07,cp.loc[cp["pos"]==p,"aa"].values[0],ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#d1495b",fontweight="bold")
axes[1].set_xlabel("TAX-2 residue position (C. elegans G5EEE2)")
axes[0].annotate("red = the 15 cGMP-pocket positions mapped from TAX-4 structure 5H3O\n"
                 "Mann-Whitney one-sided p = 7.4e-3 (orthologs), p = 1.7e-4 (CNBD panel)",
                 xy=(0.015,0.08),xycoords="axes fraction",fontsize=8.5,
                 bbox=dict(fc="white",ec="#999",alpha=0.9))
plt.show()
